title: cArcade, second round (owner, 26 October 2026: '1. E. 2. C. 3. A.')

owner_answers.1: E: all of it, in this order, without stopping: A (more games on the three boards we have, and .7z files), B (Galaga, Dig Dug, Xevious), C (1942, Time Pilot, Pooyan, Bomb Jack), D (the 68000, then Capcom's CPS-1, then the Neo Geo).
owner_answers.2: C: the owner hasn't played any arcade game in Continuum yet. So nothing is reported broken; don't put arcade tests back as 'retest'.
owner_answers.3: A: ONE build when the whole job (A to D) is done. Every push until then carries [skip ci]. Do not start a build in between, even if D takes several sessions.

rules: Same rules as tasks/arcade.json (read its hard_rules): our own Rust, GPL-3.0-only, read MAME and hardware docs for behaviour, never copy code; NEVER fetch or commit a commercial ROM, test with our own programs (assembled in scratch) and test suites; a board or set is offered only once proven against MAME 0.289 on our programs; pin the comparisons as tests that run without MAME (tests/references/<board>).
Push straight to master after every green piece, [skip ci], stage files by name, git pull --rebase first.
Green before every push: cargo test --release in cores/continuum-arcade (CI doesn't run it). When touching the app wiring: the engine checks in HANDOFF.md and the arcade_frontend test.
Never touch cores/continuum-gc/** or .github/workflows/**. Never edit native/ios/build-engine.sh.
The reference MAME: build ONCE in /projects/sandbox/.scratch/mame with .kiro/notes/wip/tools/build-mame.sh, whose SOURCES now hold every driver this round needs, so it is never rebuilt mid-round.

items.title: Pac-Man driver: the sets left out
items.detail: Eyes, Mr. TNT (address and data line swaps), Piranha's encrypted sets, the encrypted Ms. Pac-Man bootlegs, the two blue/green-swapped sets, Crush Roller, Ponpoko, Ms. Pac-Man Champion Edition (banked ROM) and whatever else in pacman.cpp runs on hardware we model or nearly. Each proven with our own programs against MAME.
items.progress: 49 sets switched on (the commit 'cArcade plays 49 more sets'): Eyes, Mr. TNT, Gorkans, Piranha and its encrypted Ms. Pac-Man bootlegs, Naughty Mouse, Crush Roller (all sets incl. Make Trax/Korosuke protection and Magic Brush), Lizard Wizard, Woodpecker, Ponpoko (upright monitor), the scrambled and blue/green-swapped Ms. Pac-Man bootlegs, Ms. Pac-Man II, Champion Edition, the Pengo bootlegs on Pac-Man hardware; all 22 test cases match MAME on every frame. Still to do in A1: Ali Baba, Dream Shopper (AY), Van-Van Car (SN76496), the Epos games (The Glob, Beastie Feastie, Eeekk!), Big Bucks and Rock trivia (question ROMs), Number Crash, Super ABC, Jump Shot (jumpshot.cpp decode), Club Pac-Man, Ms Pac Man Twin, the AY-3-8912 Crush Roller bootleg (crushs); then Jr. Pac-Man (jrpacman.cpp) and Pengo (pengo.cpp, Sega 315-5010 decryption). Skipped on purpose: sets MAME flags as imperfect or not working (birdiy, eggor, cannonbp, painter, sprglobp2), the S2650 conversions (drivfrcp, 8bpm, porky: another processor).

items.title: Galaxian driver: Jump Bug, Pisces, King & Balloon and the other near-boards
items.detail: Jump Bug (graphics banks, an AY-3-8910 we already have), Pisces (extended graphics bank), King & Balloon (its speech board), and others in galaxian.cpp that are small steps from the boards we have.
items.progress: Pisces' board in (22 sets: Pisces, UniWar S, Gingateikoku, Phoenix Part 2, Batman Part 2, Lady Bug bootleg...), galaxian::Variant::Pisces, matching MAME on all frames (tests/references/galaxian/pisces.txt, batman2.txt). The Galaxian harness (tests/galaxian/mod.rs) now lays out any set from the set list (generic_files). Next: Jump Bug (jumpbug/jumpbugbrf machines: no watchdog, AY-3-8910 at 5800h/5900h, Scramble's shots, blue background with stars kept out of the status area, 5 bank latches), King & Balloon (its speech Z80 and 4-bit DAC). Jump Bug done too (jumpbug, jumpbugb, levers; picture exact, sound within 2 of MAME). Next in A2: King & Balloon.

items.title: Donkey Kong driver: Radar Scope, Braze's kits, dkingjr, maguila, jrking
items.detail: Radar Scope (its grid and stars, its own sound), Braze's kits (the decrypting chip), the inverted colour PROM sets, jrking's 16 KB sprites.

items.title: .7z files as well as .zip
items.detail: Our own 7z reader: the container, LZMA and LZMA2 (and whatever filters arcade 7z sets use), checked against 7z files made in scratch by a real 7-Zip. App: arcade import accepts .7z, the core's valid_extensions.
items.result: cArcade reads .7z sets as well as .zip (src/sevenz.rs, our own 7z reader with LZMA and LZMA2): every file of archives the real 7-Zip 26.05 makes with 15 settings (LZMA2 and LZMA at every level, other literal/position settings, stored, solid or not, header packed or not, an end mark, a 2.6 MB file over several LZMA2 chunks) unpacks byte for byte (tests/sevenz.rs), damaged and cut-off archives are refused without a panic, a Pac-Man test set as pacman.7z plays MAME's frames through the entry points, parents are found as .7z too, and the refusal lines name .7z. The app's import already keeps arcade 7z files packed.
